Northern Sotho: Go ya ka dinyakišišo tša go fapafapana, kgatelelo ya monagano, tlalelo le bolwetši bja ka morago ga masetlapelo (PTSD) ke mathata ao a amanago le seemo se sebotse sa monagano magareng ga bafaladi le batšwantle.
Amharic: በተለያዩ ጥናቶች መሰረት፣ ድብርት፣ ፍርሃት፣ እና የድህረ-ስቃይ ጭንቀት (PTSD) በፍልሰተኞች እና በስደተኞች ዘንድ የተለመዱ የአእምሮ ጤና ጉዳዮች ናቸው።

Source: PTSD is usually the result of surviving dangerous or damaging events, and people often experience the after-effects of those negative events for months, or even years.
Luganda: PTSD etera okuva ku kusimattuka ebintu eby’omutawaana, era abantu batera okubeera n’obuzibu obuva ku mbeera ezo embi okumala emyezi egiwerako, oba n’emyaka.
Yoruba: PTSD ló ṣábà máa ń jẹ́ àbájáde ìjàjàbọ́ lọ́wọ́ àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ewu tàbí apanirun, àwọn ènìyàn sì máa ń ní ìrírí àtubọ̀tán àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ òdí yìí fún ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ oṣùn, tàbí ọdun gan-an pàápàá.
Zulu: I-PTSD ngokuvamile iwumphumela wokusinda ezigamekweni eziyingozi noma ezilimazayo, futhi abantu bavame ukuzwa imiphumela yalezo zigameko ezimbi izinyanga, noma iminyaka.
Hausa: PTSD yana faruwa ne yawanci a sakamakon tsira mai haɗari ko abubuwan da suka faru na ɓarna, kuma mutane sukan fuskanci sakamakon abubuwan da suka faru marasa kyau na tsawon watanni, ko ma na shekaru.
Northern Sotho: Gantši PTSD e bakwa ke go efoga ditiragalo tše kotsi goba tše di senyago, le gona batho gantši ba itemogela ditlamorago tša ditiragalo tšeo tša go se kgahliše dikgwedikgwedi, ešita le yona mengwaga.
Amharic: PTSD ብዙውን ጊዜ ከአደገኛ ወይም ጎጂ ክስተቶች በሕይወት የመትረፍ ውጤት ነው፣ እና ሰዎች ብዙውን ጊዜ የእነዚያን አሉታዊ ክስተቶች ለወራት አልፎ ተርፎም ለዓመታት የሚያስከትለው ውጤት ያጋጥማቸዋል።

Source: In this study, researchers wanted to understand the different factors that play a role in migrant mental health problems like PTSD.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera ensonga ez’enjawulo ezirina kye zikola ku mbeera z’ebirowoozo by’abawaŋŋanguka nga PTSD.
Yoruba: Ní inú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ ní òye àwọn kókó ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ tí ó ń kópa nínu àwọn ìṣòró ìlera ọpọlọ àwọn aṣíkiri bíi PTSD.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuqonda izici ezihlukene ezidlala indima ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo yabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe njenge-PTSD.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun so su fahimci abubuwa daban-daban waɗanda suke taka rawa a cikin matsalolin lafiyar ƙwaƙwala na baƙon haure kamar PTSD.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go kwešiša dintlha tše di fapanego tšeo di kgathago tema go mathata a go amana le seemo sa monagano a bafaladi a go swana le PTSD.

Source: They therefore conducted a type of study called a review, where they summarised information from multiple other studies on the subject, to find common trends or themes.
